# Sudz Up Detailing LLC

> One auto detailing shop at 2948 WI-83. Customers drive in from across Washington, Waukesha, Ozaukee, Dodge, Fond du Lac and Milwaukee counties. One vehicle at a time; interior, exterior and full details, odor removal, paint correction, ceramic coating, interior protection, engine bays and headlight restoration.

Shop-based, not mobile: every vehicle is brought to the shop in Hartford, Wisconsin. Phone and text 414-286-1609. Email gio@sudzupdetail.com. Hours: Monday – Friday 8am-6pm; Saturday – Sunday closed. Owner: Gio. Pricing: Sudz Quick Clean interior $135 cars / $150 SUVs and trucks; Sudz Up VIP Clean full interior and exterior $200 / $250; engine bay $50 add-on; headlight restoration from $135; odor removal, paint correction, ceramic coating and interior protection assessed and quoted per vehicle. Quotes are given before work starts, never at collection.

## Services

- [Full Interior & Exterior Detail](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/full-detail/): From $200. The complete reset — interior and exterior, done in sequence over a full day.
- [Interior Detailing](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/interior-detailing/): From $135. Compressed air, deep vacuum, extraction, surface treatment and glass — the interior done properly.
- [Exterior Detailing](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/exterior-detailing/): Quoted. Two-bucket hand wash, iron removal, clay decontamination and protection.
- [Odor Removal](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/odor-removal/): Quoted. Smoke, pet, mildew and spill odors — found at the source and removed, not masked.
- [Paint Correction](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/paint-correction/): Quoted. Machine polishing to permanently remove swirls, scratches and oxidation.
- [Interior Protection](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/interior-protection/): Quoted. Fabric sealant and leather or vinyl coating applied to a freshly detailed interior.
- [Engine Bay Cleaning](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/engine-bay-cleaning/): $50. Degreased, safely rinsed and dressed matte. $50 with any detail.
- [Headlight Restoration](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/headlight-restoration/): From $135. Yellowed, hazed lenses wet-sanded, polished and UV-sealed. From $135.
- [Ceramic Coating](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/ceramic-coating/): Quoted. Semi-permanent paint protection — decontamination, prep and coating application.
- [Truck & SUV Detailing](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/truck-and-suv-detailing/): From $150. Work trucks, family SUVs and third-row vehicles. More space, more time.

## By vehicle, situation and make

- [Truck Detailing](https://sudzupdetail.com/vehicles/truck-detailing/): A truck is not a big car. The bed, the cab layout and the way it is used all change what needs doing and where the time goes.
- [SUV Detailing](https://sudzupdetail.com/vehicles/suv-detailing/): The thing that makes an SUV useful — the space behind the second row — is the thing that makes it hard to keep clean, because nobody sits there and nobody cleans there.
- [Minivan Detailing](https://sudzupdetail.com/vehicles/minivan-detailing/): A minivan is the hardest interior in consumer motoring, and it has three features that no other vehicle has and every one of them collects dirt.
- [Leather & Luxury Interiors](https://sudzupdetail.com/vehicles/leather-and-luxury-interiors/): A luxury interior is not harder to clean than a standard one. It is easier to damage, because every surface in it is a different material with a different failure mode.
- [Before You Sell](https://sudzupdetail.com/situations/before-you-sell/): A full detail is the cheapest thing you can do to a car before you sell it, and the reason is not that it looks nicer. It is what a buyer decides the condition means.
- [Just Bought a Used Car](https://sudzupdetail.com/situations/just-bought-used/): You do not know who was in it or what they did in it. One full detail at the start gives you a car whose condition you actually know, and it usually finds a few things.
- [New Car Protection](https://sudzupdetail.com/situations/new-car-protection/): The first month is the only time a car is genuinely clean, and it is the only time protection goes on without anything to fix first. Every month after that, the same job costs more.
- [Tesla](https://sudzupdetail.com/makes/tesla/): Tesla paint is the softest and thinnest we regularly work on, and that single fact changes the advice for everything else about the car.
- [Porsche](https://sudzupdetail.com/makes/porsche/): Porsche paint is among the hardest we work on, which is good news for correction and bad news for anyone who assumes it therefore does not need care.
- [Land Rover & Range Rover](https://sudzupdetail.com/makes/land-rover-range-rover/): A Range Rover is a luxury interior on a vehicle that its owners actually take places, and those two facts are in constant tension.
- [Jeep Wrangler](https://sudzupdetail.com/makes/jeep-wrangler/): A Wrangler is the only vehicle we work on that was designed to have its interior hosed out, and that changes almost everything about how it should be cleaned.
- [Ford F-150](https://sudzupdetail.com/makes/ford-f-150/): The F-150 has had an aluminum body for a decade, and most owners have never had anyone explain what that changes about looking after it.
- [Chevrolet Corvette](https://sudzupdetail.com/makes/corvette/): A Corvette's panels are not metal, and that changes how heat, correction and dents behave in ways most owners have never had spelled out.
- [Subaru](https://sudzupdetail.com/makes/subaru/): Subarus have soft paint and owners who take them outdoors, which is a combination that produces the most predictable wear pattern of any make we see.

## Commercial and trade

- [Car Dealers](https://sudzupdetail.com/commercial/car-dealers/): We are not a lot-wash service. We are where a dealer sends the trade-in that the lot wash cannot fix.
- [Dealer Ceramic Coating Programs](https://sudzupdetail.com/commercial/dealer-ceramic-coating/): Dealer-sold coatings get a bad name for one reason: they are usually applied badly. We are the installer that fixes that.
- [Fleet & Company Vehicles](https://sudzupdetail.com/commercial/fleet-detailing/): A company vehicle is a rolling advertisement and a workplace at the same time, and it takes a beating that no private car does.
- [Trade Partners](https://sudzupdetail.com/commercial/partners/): If you run an auto business and detailing is not what you do, you still get asked for it. We are the answer to that question.

## Where customers drive in from

- [Chenequa, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/chenequa-wi/): About 25 minutes from the shop. Chenequa is a village of large wooded lakefront lots, and the vehicles that live on them have a problem most of our customers would be glad to have: there are several of them, and they are not all used the same way.
- [Oconomowoc Lake, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/oconomowoc-lake-wi/): About 25 minutes from the shop. The village of Oconomowoc Lake is the shoreline. Every property faces the water, and every vehicle in it lives with what a lake does to paint and interiors at closer range than anywhere else in Lake Country.
- [River Hills, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/river-hills-wi/): About 45 minutes from the shop. River Hills is a village of five-acre minimum lots on the Milwaukee River, and it is the one place in Milwaukee County where a garage is more likely to hold a collector car than a commuter.
- [Horicon, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/horicon-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Horicon sits on the edge of the largest freshwater cattail marsh in the United States, and living next to a marsh does things to a vehicle that living next to a lake does not.
- [Mayville, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/mayville-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Mayville is a manufacturing town on the Rock River at the north end of the marsh, and every autumn it fills with trucks that have spent the morning in a duck blind.
- [Watertown, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/watertown-wi/): About 35 minutes from the shop. Watertown is the western edge of where our customers come from, and it has a road running through it that no other town our customers come from has to live with.
- [Campbellsport, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/campbellsport-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Campbellsport is snowmobile country in the winter and Kettle Moraine trail country the rest of the year, and both leave a vehicle in a state that a wash does not address.
- [Elm Grove, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/elm-grove-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Elm Grove has more mature canopy per street than anywhere our customers come from, and a vehicle that lives under old oaks takes a specific kind of damage across the whole year.
- [New Berlin, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/new-berlin-wi/): About 40 minutes from the shop. New Berlin is two places. The north half is one of the largest industrial parks in Wisconsin and the south half is horse country, and they send us completely different vehicles.
- [Milwaukee, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/milwaukee-wi/): 35–45 minutes from the shop. Milwaukee is the edge of where we make sense, and this page is an honest account of which Milwaukee vehicles are worth the drive out.
- [Wauwatosa, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/wauwatosa-wi/): About 35 minutes from the shop. Wauwatosa has one of the largest medical campuses in the state, and a large share of its vehicles belong to people who work twelve-hour shifts in it.
- [Brookfield, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/brookfield-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Brookfield sends us more vehicles that carry clients than anywhere else, and a vehicle that carries clients is judged from the passenger seat.
- [Waukesha, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/waukesha-wi/): About 35 minutes from the shop. Waukesha is the county seat and the largest city our customers come from, and it has a river running through the middle of it that periodically reminds everyone it is there.
- [Fond du Lac, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/fond-du-lac-wi/): About 40 minutes from the shop. Fond du Lac sits at the bottom of Lake Winnebago, and the lake sets its calendar in two ways that no other town our customers come from experiences.
- [Beaver Dam, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/beaver-dam-wi/): About 35 minutes from the shop. Beaver Dam Lake is big, shallow and green in summer, and that green ends up on the vehicles that use it.
- [Saukville, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/saukville-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Saukville is one of the few places our customers come from with heavy industry in the village itself, and that shows up on paint in a way most owners have never had explained to them.
- [Port Washington, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/port-washington-wi/): About 40 minutes from the shop. Port Washington is the only harbour town whose vehicles come to us, and harbour vehicles have problems that come straight off the water.
- [Pewaukee, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/pewaukee-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Pewaukee has the largest lake in Waukesha County running straight into its downtown, and unlike most lake towns it does not stop using the lake when it freezes.
- [Delafield, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/delafield-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Delafield sits at the foot of Lapham Peak, and it is the one town in our customer base whose vehicles are busiest in the cold months rather than the warm ones.
- [Grafton, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/grafton-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Grafton has become the retail centre for this part of Ozaukee County, and a big retail corridor does a specific and underrated kind of damage to the cars that use it.
- [Menomonee Falls, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/menomonee-falls-wi/): About 25 minutes from the shop. Menomonee Falls is the largest village in Wisconsin, and it has a corporate and industrial base that makes its vehicle population unlike any of the towns closer to us.
- [Sussex, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/sussex-wi/): About 25 minutes from the shop. Sussex has been building for years, and a village under construction does specific and predictable things to the vehicles living in it.
- [Hartland, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/hartland-wi/): About 25 minutes from the shop. Hartland is an outdoor town on the edge of Lake Country, and outdoor households wear their vehicles out from the back forward.
- [Lannon, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/lannon-wi/): About 25 minutes from the shop. Lannon is a village built around a stone, and that stone gets into every vehicle that lives there.
- [Hubertus, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/hubertus-wi/): About 15 minutes from the shop. Hubertus is a small unincorporated community with an outsized amount of other people's traffic passing through it.
- [Cedarburg, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/cedarburg-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Cedarburg's historic downtown is the reason people visit, and it is also the reason local vehicles live a harder life than the size of the city suggests.
- [Ashippun, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/ashippun-wi/): About 15 minutes from the shop. Ashippun is dairy country, and dairy country vehicles have a set of problems that are entirely about what is on the roads and what comes in on boots.
- [Oconomowoc, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/oconomowoc-wi/): About 25 minutes from the shop. Oconomowoc runs on a seasonal rhythm that almost nowhere else our customers come from does, and it changes both what vehicles need and when they need it.
- [Mequon, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/mequon-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Mequon is unusual for a suburb — large lots, long private drives and a lake three miles east — and each of those leaves a distinct mark on a vehicle.
- [Hartford, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/hartford-wi/): Home base from the shop. We are based on WI-83 in Hartford. This is the town we work in every day, and it is the one place where we can usually fit a vehicle in on short notice.
- [West Bend, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/west-bend-wi/): About 20 minutes from the shop. West Bend is the largest community our customers come from and about a twenty minute run from our shop in Hartford. It is worth the drive, and here is what we typically find in a West Bend vehicle.
- [Slinger, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/slinger-wi/): About 10 minutes from the shop. Slinger is about ten minutes east of our shop. Between the Speedway and Little Switzerland, it produces two of the most distinctive vehicle messes in the county.
- [Germantown, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/germantown-wi/): About 25 minutes from the shop. Germantown sits on the busiest highway corridor in the county. That shapes almost everything about how the vehicles we see from there wear.
- [Richfield, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/richfield-wi/): About 15 minutes from the shop. Richfield kept its rural character while growing to nearly twelve thousand residents. The mix of gravel side roads and highway commuting gives its vehicles a split personality.
- [Jackson, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/jackson-wi/): About 20 minutes from the shop. Jackson is one of the fastest growing communities in Washington County, about seven miles south of West Bend. Growing communities mean family vehicles, and family vehicles mean interiors.
- [Kewaskum, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/kewaskum-wi/): About 30 minutes from the shop. Kewaskum calls itself the gateway to the Kettle Moraine, and that is exactly the problem. Recreation vehicles come back dirtier than commuter vehicles, every time.
- [Allenton, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/allenton-wi/): About 12 minutes from the shop. Allenton is a small community on the US 41 corridor north of Hartford, surrounded by working farmland. Work vehicles outnumber show vehicles here, and we detail accordingly.
- [Colgate, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/colgate-wi/): About 18 minutes from the shop. Colgate is a small unincorporated community in the south of the county, sharing the 53017 ZIP with Richfield. Rural, quiet, and hard on the lower half of a vehicle.
- [Erin, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/erin-wi/): About 10 minutes from the shop. Erin is rural Washington County at its most scenic, and it is home to Erin Hills, the public course that hosted the 2017 U.S. Open. Golf traffic gives its vehicles a specific signature.
- [Rubicon, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/rubicon-wi/): About 12 minutes from the shop. Rubicon is just over the line into Dodge County, west of Hartford. It is farm country, and farm country vehicles have needs that a car wash does not address.
- [Neosho, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/auto-detailing/neosho-wi/): About 18 minutes from the shop. Neosho is a small Dodge County village west of Hartford. There is not much in the way of detailing options out that way, which is exactly why we list it.

## Optional

- [Interior Detailing in Slinger, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/interior-detailing/slinger-wi/): Slinger is about ten minutes from our shop, and it sends us a kind of interior work we do not get from anywhere else in the county.
- [Interior Detailing in West Bend, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/interior-detailing/west-bend-wi/): West Bend is the largest community our customers come from, and its vehicles arrive with the most consistent wear pattern of anywhere in the county.
- [Odor Removal in Kewaskum, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/odor-removal/kewaskum-wi/): Kewaskum sits at the north end of our area, right against the Kettle Moraine, and the odor work we get from up there is genuinely different from what comes out of the suburbs.
- [Full Interior & Exterior Detail in Oconomowoc, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/full-detail/oconomowoc-wi/): Oconomowoc is Lake Country, and lake vehicles take a specific kind of beating that a standard detail schedule does not account for.
- [Full Interior & Exterior Detail in Mequon, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/full-detail/mequon-wi/): Mequon drivers pass a lot of detailers on the way here, so this page is mostly an argument about why some of them do it anyway.
- [Ceramic Coating in Germantown, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/ceramic-coating/germantown-wi/): Germantown sits on the I-41 corridor, which makes it one of the strongest cases for coating anywhere in our area — and one of the places the honest downside matters most.
- [Interior Detailing in Hartford, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/interior-detailing/hartford-wi/): This is the town we work in every day, and after a few years of it we can usually guess which part of Hartford a vehicle comes from before the owner tells us.
- [Interior Detailing in Erin, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/interior-detailing/erin-wi/): Erin is rural, hilly and home to a championship golf course, and between those three things it sends us interiors unlike anywhere else in the county.
- [Interior Detailing in Germantown, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/interior-detailing/germantown-wi/): Germantown sends us more family vehicles than anywhere else our customers come from, and family vehicles fail in a completely predictable pattern that most detailing skips.
- [Odor Removal in West Bend, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/odor-removal/west-bend-wi/): West Bend has the highest turnover of used vehicles in our area, and a large share of the odor work we get from there arrives with a car that somebody just bought.
- [Full Interior & Exterior Detail in Jackson, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/full-detail/jackson-wi/): Jackson runs on shift work and light industry, and vehicles that live around a shift pattern wear differently from vehicles that live around an office day.
- [Exterior Detailing in Richfield, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/exterior-detailing/richfield-wi/): Richfield is large, rural and hilly, and its roads do things to paint that suburban streets simply do not.
- [Odor Removal in Allenton, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/odor-removal/allenton-wi/): Allenton is a small farming community, and agricultural odor work is a genuinely different discipline from cleaning up after a spilled coffee.
- [Paint Correction in West Bend, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/paint-correction/west-bend-wi/): West Bend has more automatic car washes per driver than anywhere else in our area, and almost every correction job we get from there traces back to them.
- [Interior Detailing in Sussex, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/interior-detailing/sussex-wi/): The single most common thing in a Sussex cabin is dust from a house that is not yours, and it is a genuinely awkward kind of dust to remove.
- [Ceramic Coating in Sussex, WI](https://sudzupdetail.com/services/ceramic-coating/sussex-wi/): Sussex is the one place our customers come from where the case for coating a new car is strongest, and it is entirely because of what is in the air.
